# Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths with platform-standard directories

## Context

Five modules use `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy")` to store user-level data, which puts everything under `~/.bivvy/` regardless of platform. Meanwhile, six other modules already correctly use `dirs::cache_dir()` and `dirs::data_local_dir()`. This inconsistency means config, state, and templates don't follow XDG (Linux) or Application Support (macOS) conventions.

## Approach

Create a centralized `src/paths.rs` module that provides all Bivvy directory paths using platform-standard locations. Update the 5 hardcoded callers to use it, and also migrate the already-correct modules to use the centralized module for consistency.

### Platform path mapping

| Purpose | Old path | New base | Linux | macOS | Windows |
|---------|----------|----------|-------|-------|---------|
| User config | `~/.bivvy/config.yml` | `dirs::config_dir()` | `~/.config/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/` | `%APPDATA%\bivvy\` |
| User templates | `~/.bivvy/templates/` | `dirs::config_dir()` | `~/.config/bivvy/templates/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/templates/` | `%APPDATA%\bivvy\templates\` |
| Project state | `~/.bivvy/projects/` | `dirs::data_local_dir()` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/projects/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/projects/` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bivvy\projects\` |
| Project index | `~/.bivvy/projects/index.yml` | `dirs::data_local_dir()` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/projects/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/projects/` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bivvy\projects\` |
| Failure reports | `~/.bivvy/failure-reports/` | `dirs::data_local_dir()` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/failure-reports/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/failure-reports/` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bivvy\failure-reports\` |
| Cache (already correct) | `dirs::cache_dir()` | no change | `~/.cache/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Caches/bivvy/` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bivvy\` |
| Sessions (already correct) | `dirs::data_local_dir()` | no change | `~/.local/share/bivvy/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\bivvy\` |

## Steps

### 1. Create `src/paths.rs` — centralized path module

New file with these public functions:

```rust
/// Bivvy config directory (user-level config files and templates).
/// Linux: ~/.config/bivvy, macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy
pub fn config_dir() -> PathBuf

/// Bivvy data directory (project state, index, failure reports).
/// Linux: ~/.local/share/bivvy, macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy
pub fn data_dir() -> PathBuf

/// Bivvy cache directory (template cache, remote configs, update checks).
/// Linux: ~/.cache/bivvy, macOS: ~/Library/Caches/bivvy
pub fn cache_dir() -> PathBuf

// Convenience functions:
pub fn user_config_file() -> Option<PathBuf>     // config_dir()/config.yml
pub fn user_templates_dir() -> PathBuf           // config_dir()/templates
pub fn projects_dir() -> PathBuf                 // data_dir()/projects
pub fn project_state_dir(hash: &str) -> PathBuf  // data_dir()/projects/{hash}
pub fn project_index_file() -> PathBuf           // data_dir()/projects/index.yml
pub fn failure_reports_dir() -> PathBuf          // data_dir()/failure-reports
pub fn sessions_dir() -> PathBuf                 // data_dir()/sessions
pub fn feedback_file() -> PathBuf                // data_dir()/feedback.jsonl
```

Fallback behavior: If `dirs::config_dir()` returns `None`, fall back to `PathBuf::from(".")` (matching existing pattern in cache/session/feedback modules).

### 2. Register the module in `src/lib.rs`

Add `pub mod paths;`

### 3. Update hardcoded callers (the 5 broken modules)

- **`src/config/loader.rs:48`** — `find_user_global()`: replace `dirs::home_dir()?.join(".bivvy").join("config.yml")` with `paths::user_config_file()`
- **`src/registry/local.rs:36`** — `user_templates_dir()`: replace `dirs::home_dir().map(|h| h.join(".bivvy").join("templates"))` with `Some(paths::user_templates_dir())`
- **`src/state/store.rs:118-124`** — `state_dir()`: replace `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy").join("projects").join(hash)` with `paths::project_state_dir(hash)`
- **`src/state/index.rs:31-37`** — `file_path()`: replace `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy").join("projects").join("index.yml")` with `paths::project_index_file()`
- **`src/runner/telemetry.rs:204-209`** — `reports_dir()`: replace `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy").join("failure-reports")` with `paths::failure_reports_dir()`

### 4. Migrate already-correct modules to use centralized paths

- **`src/cache/mod.rs`** — `default_cache_dir()`: delegate to `paths::cache_dir().join("templates")`
- **`src/session/mod.rs`** — `default_store_path()`: delegate to `paths::sessions_dir()`
- **`src/feedback/mod.rs`** — `default_store_path()`: delegate to `paths::feedback_file()`

### 5. Update doc comments and module-level docs

Update references to `~/.bivvy/` in doc comments across modified files to reflect platform-standard paths.

### 6. Add tests

- Unit tests in `src/paths.rs` verifying each function returns a path ending with the expected segments
- Verify existing tests still pass (they use tempfile for project-local paths)

## Files to modify

- `src/paths.rs` (new)
- `src/lib.rs`
- `src/config/loader.rs`
- `src/registry/local.rs`
- `src/state/store.rs`
- `src/state/index.rs`
- `src/runner/telemetry.rs`
- `src/cache/mod.rs`
- `src/session/mod.rs`
- `src/feedback/mod.rs`

## Verification

```bash
cargo test --all-features
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo build --all-targets --all-features
```
